Meta will also increase team-building initiatives and scale back manager oversight.

The facility leverages OCI and Oracle Autonomous AI Database to turn data into actionable intelligence. TCS plans to expand to four more cities in three years, supported by 26,000 Oracle-skilled professionals.

ai.title: OpenAI under investigation by group of state attorneys general
ai.description: A group of US state attorneys general has started a wide-ranging probe into OpenAI. The ChatGPT maker received a subpoena seeking documents on its operations and user impact. This investigation includes data handling, minors, seniors, and internal policies. OpenAI faces increasing legal scrutiny as it prepares for an IPO. The company stated it takes concerns seriously and will engage constructively.
